1.explanation: The only compressed file that defines any grid‐breakpoint settings is grid.config.js, which drives the number of columns and underpinning values for each breakpoint. Although the actual gutter value may be injected in the Sass, the max breakpoint’s configuration is controlled here (it currently derives from the default 16px), so updating the max breakpoint margin to 24px (and syncing any corresponding Sass variables) must begin in this file.
1.bug_scenario: On the Carbon website and in Sketch artboards, the “max” grid breakpoint shows a gutter/margin of 24px, but in the live code preview it is still 16px. The screenshots illustrate a wider pink grid on the left at 24px in the spec vs. a narrower gray grid at 16px in the code.

2.explanation: The only file in the compressed list that defines the grid’s breakpoint context is grid.config.js. It is where the “max” breakpoint is declared (with its column count and (indirectly) its gutter settings for the preview). To correct the outer margin at the max breakpoint from 16px to 24px, this configuration (or the SCSS that consumes its values) will need to be updated. None of the other files (the tests or snapshots) contain breakpoint or margin definitions, so grid.config.js is the key place to start.
2.bug_scenario: The user is comparing the “Max” breakpoint in the Carbon Grid preview to the specs on the website and in Sketch. In the live preview (and generated CSS) the outer gutter at the max breakpoint is only 16px, but the design documentation calls for 24px. The screenshots show the grid at “max-1584px-16 column” with only 16px of margin on either side, instead of the expected 24px.
